name: vi-gross-receipts-tax
description: US Virgin Islands gross receipts tax reference using the August 2026 monthly return and the currently linked annual return. Covers the receipts base, five-percent rate, monthly exemption calculation, filing categories, deadlines, sole-proprietor consolidation, zero returns and documented government withholding. Includes examples showing why the monthly exemption is not an annual pooled deduction. Explicitly distinguishes the annual-filing boundary from the exemption wording at exactly 225,000 dollars. Uses official BIR forms while leaving the complete statutory amendment audit outstanding. Does not establish incentives, nexus, special-sector exemptions or the right to charge customers a separate tax. Independent accountant review remains pending.
